# T4 — the rename tool and its rehearsal

## 1. Summary

`tools/rename.ps1` renames the project identity in a copy of the template: the six
spellings the name appears in, across file content, file names and folder names, with
each `.meta` renamed beside its file so GUIDs survive. It is excluded from nothing that
carries the name by mistake — `.git`, binaries, the examples archive, `ORIGIN.md` and
the `*.cs` files `gen.ps1` owns — and it reports the Unity assets that were named after
the project. `-DryRun` prints the plan without touching the tree, a second run finds
nothing to change, and `-PatchFile` rewrites a `generic:` commit's diff instead for the
upgrade path.

The tool was rehearsed the way it will be used: a throwaway copy of the working tree,
its own `git init`, the pinned toolchain, the rename, `gen.ps1`, a commit,
`verify-generated`, both halves of `tools/test.ps1 -Suite Full` (which needs two runs —
the WebGL build needs the Editor closed, the Unity suites need it open), and Playwright
in Chrome against the renamed player. The copy was deleted and nothing from it was
committed here. Details and measurements:
[`rename-rehearsal.md`](rename-rehearsal.md).

The rehearsal earned its place: it caught a real gap in the first attempt, where two
hand-written `.asmdef` files inside `lib/Runtime/Generated/` kept the old name and would
have broken every assembly that references them. See §4 of the rehearsal log.

## 2. What the tool does

| Input | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `-From ProjectSurvive -To JianghuAlmanac` | six forms at once: `ProjectSurvive`, `projectSurvive`, `projectsurvive`, `project-survive`, `PROJECT_SURVIVE`, `PROJECTSURVIVE`; forms that collapse (a one-word name) are de-duplicated |
| `-DryRun` | the plan — files, folders, per-file replacement counts — and no write |
| `-PatchFile <p>` | rewrites a patch instead: header paths and hunk text together, output as `<name>.renamed<patch>` |
| no `-From`/`-To` | exit 2, with the reason (`-From` must be PascalCase, the two names may not contain each other) |
| a target name already exists | exit 1 **before writing anything**; a collision cannot leave a half-renamed tree |
| an unreadable/locked file | exit 1 before writing anything, naming the file |
| after a successful run | a residual scan: any old form left in a file the tool owns is an error, not a warning |

## 3. Acceptance

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Six case forms replaced, and only that token — never `survive`/`survivor` on its own | **PASS** | probe file through a real copy: `a survivor-like game: survive Survive SURVIVOR survivors` came back byte-identical while the six forms on the next line were all replaced. Replacement is ordinal `String.Replace` over six exact strings, so a general word cannot match |
| 2 | Content **and** file/folder names, `.meta` renamed with its file, covering asmdef, csproj, sln, package.json, manifest.json, packages-lock.json, luban.conf, `csharp_namespace`, ProjectSettings, jslib, `tests/web` | **PASS** | rehearsal §3: **201 files / 833 replacements**, **46 files + 2 folders renamed** (14 `.asmdef` + `.meta` = 28, 11 `.csproj`, the `.sln`, the `.jslib` + `.meta`, the 2 URP assets + `.meta` = 46), 0 old names left. Per-artifact: `lib/package.json` (6), `UnityProject/Packages/manifest.json` (1) and `packages-lock.json` (1, untracked but walked from disk), `data/luban.conf` (1), `proto/app.proto` (3: `csharp_namespace`), `ProjectSettings.asset` (`companyName`, `productName`), `tests/web/globals.mjs` + `WebGlBridge.cs` (`__projectSurvive*`) |
| 3 | Excluded: `.git`, `Library`, `Temp`, `Logs`, `obj`, `bin`, `UserSettings`, `node_modules`, `artifacts`, `Builds`, generated code, examples, `ORIGIN.md`, binaries | **PASS** | the run's own counters (2 skipped folders, 13 skipped paths: `.git`, `tools/vendor`, the examples archive, `ORIGIN.md`, the ten `.cs` files `gen.ps1` owns) and 13 non-text files skipped (12 NuGet `.signature.p7s` under `Assets/Packages/`, `Assets/NuGet/README.pdf`, plus the `.bytes` tables by extension). The old name surviving in any of them cannot break a build: the excluded `.cs` are regenerated by `gen.ps1` |
| 4 | `-DryRun` writes nothing; a second run changes nothing | **PASS** | template-repo `-DryRun`: exit 0, no write. A fresh copy renamed twice: run 1 = 201 files/833 replacements, run 2 = **0 files, 0 replacements**, dry run 3 = `already renamed (idempotent)` |
| 5 | `-PatchFile` rewrites a patch's text | **PASS** | a real `generic:` commit (`5f5118a`): 34 occurrences → 34 replaced, 0 left, and `git apply --stat` still parses the result (28 files changed, exit 0) |
| 6 | `.unity` / `.prefab` / `.asset` files that carried the old name are reported separately | **PASS** | the rehearsal run printed the two URP assets (`ProjectSurviveURP.asset`, `ProjectSurviveURP_Renderer.asset`) and their `.meta`; no `.unity`/`.prefab` in this tree is named after the project |
| 7 | The rehearsal: copy → `git init` → setup-tools → rename → gen → commit → verify-generated → Full → Web build + Playwright → delete, nothing committed back | **PASS** | [`rename-rehearsal.md`](rename-rehearsal.md) §2: 12 steps, all PASS across the two Full runs (**PASS 10 / FAIL 0 / NOT RUN 2** each, the NOT RUN pair being the documented Editor-lock split); nothing from the copy is in this repo |

**DoD**

| Requirement | Verdict | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |

| Results recorded in `docs/template/rename-rehearsal.md`, including the first import time | **PASS** | [`rename-rehearsal.md`](rename-rehearsal.md) §2 step 8: `unity open` → `unity status` = `ready` in **2 min 4 s** on a copy with no `Library` |

## 4. Not tested, and risks

- **`link.xml`, `InternalsVisibleTo` and a non-empty `applicationIdentifier` do not
  exist in this tree**, so the tool's handling of them is reasoned, not measured: they
  are ordinary text files, matched by the same six strings. `ProjectSettings.asset`
  carries `applicationIdentifier: {}` today. A game that adds any of them gets it
  renamed; the rehearsal cannot prove a case the template does not contain.
- **No Release build, no size profile.** The rehearsal's player is Development
  (117,521,059 bytes) and its 449.8 s build is a correctness number, not a quote-able
  one (ADR 0003).
- **`setup-tools.ps1` reported "already installed"** in the rehearsal because
  `tools/vendor/` was copied with the tree. The download-and-verify path is T1/T2
  evidence, not T4's.
- **A rename is still a large diff in a game's own history.** The tool refuses to run
  if the new name already exists anywhere, which is the cheap guard against running it
  twice with different arguments; it cannot tell whether a *stale* old name belongs to
  the game's own old game or to a file it should have changed.
- **Renamed assets keep their GUID but not their name string.** `m_Name` and menu paths
  are text and were rewritten; a game that had its own asset named after the template's
  project should eyeball the printed list.
- **`lib/package.json`'s author URL** becomes the new name's URL rather than a real one;
  a game sets its own metadata.
- **The tool never touches `git`** — no history rewrite, no commit. That is deliberate:
  the game's first commit is its own, and `docs/template/README.md` says so.

## 5. Commands actually run

```powershell
# the tool, on a scratch fixture (unit cases) and on the template repo
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/rename.ps1 -From ProjectSurvive -To JianghuAlmanac -DryRun
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/rename.ps1 -From ProjectSurvive -To ProjectRenameProbe -DryRun

# the rehearsal (throwaway copy at C:\Workspace\_rename-rehearsal, deleted afterwards)
robocopy C:\Workspace\ProjectSurvive-template C:\Workspace\_rename-rehearsal /E /XD .git Library Temp Logs obj bin UserSettings node_modules artifacts Builds
git init -b main ; git add -A ; git commit -m "rehearsal: copy of the template before the rename"
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/setup-tools.ps1                                       # PASS 2 | FAIL 0,        3 s
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/rename.ps1 -From ProjectSurvive -To ProjectRenameProbe # 201 files/833, 46+2 names, 2 s
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/gen.ps1                                                # OK, configHash DDFDF338…, 11 s
git add -A ; git commit -m "rehearsal: rename ProjectSurvive -> ProjectRenameProbe and regenerate"   # 221 files
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/verify-generated.ps1                                   # PASS 9 | FAIL 0,       55 s
npm ci --prefix tests/web                                                          # 2 s (node_modules was excluded)
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/test.ps1 -Suite Full                                   # PASS 10 | NOT RUN 2,  589 s
unity open C:\Workspace\_rename-rehearsal\UnityProject                             # import -> ready,   2 min 4 s
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/test.ps1 -Suite Full                                   # PASS 10 | NOT RUN 2,   75 s
git grep -il projectsurvive                                                        # 10 files: ORIGIN + examples
unity close C:\Workspace\_rename-rehearsal\UnityProject
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\Workspace\_rename-rehearsal                         # nothing kept

# the idempotency and patch-mode checks
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/rename.ps1 -From ProjectSurvive -To ProjectRenameProbe  # twice on a fresh copy; the 2nd: 0 changes
git format-patch -1 5f5118a -o /tmp/patchcheck
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/rename.ps1 -From ProjectSurvive -To ProjectRenameProbe -PatchFile /tmp/patchcheck/0001-*.patch
git apply --stat /tmp/patchcheck/0001-*.renamed.patch                              # 28 files, exit 0

# this repository, after the edits above
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/test.ps1 -Suite Fast                                   # PASS 9 | FAIL 0 | NOT RUN 3, 156.8 s
node tools/check-links.mjs
```
